purpose: Private unexecuted reference/alternate source for root tests, never assignment starter

shell-map-lookup.primary:
declare -A owners
owners["$KEY_A"]="$VALUE_A"
owners["$KEY_B"]="$VALUE_B"
owners["$KEY_C"]="$VALUE_C"
for request in "$@"; do
    if [ -z "$request" ]; then
        printf '%s: %s\n' "$request" unknown
    else
        found="${owners[$request]}"
        if [ -n "$found" ]; then
            printf '%s: %s\n' "$request" "$found"
        else
            printf '%s: %s\n' "$request" unknown
        fi
    fi
done
shell-map-lookup.alternate:
for request in "$@"; do
    if [ "$request" = "$KEY_A" ]; then
        answer=$VALUE_A
    else
        if [ "$request" = "$KEY_B" ]; then
            answer=$VALUE_B
        else
            if [ "$request" = "$KEY_C" ]; then
                answer=$VALUE_C
            else
                answer=unknown
            fi
        fi
    fi
    printf '%s: %s\n' "$request" "$answer"
done

shell-map-reconcile.primary:
declare -A latest
rejected=0
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    case "$line" in
        *'|'*'|'*)
            printf 'Skipped: %s\n' "$line" >&2
            rejected=$((rejected + 1))
            ;;
        *'|'*)
            key=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d '|' -f 1)
            if [ -z "$key" ]; then
                printf 'Skipped: %s\n' "$line" >&2
                rejected=$((rejected + 1))
            else
                value=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d '|' -f 2)
                latest["$key"]="$value"
            fi
            ;;
        *)
            printf 'Skipped: %s\n' "$line" >&2
            rejected=$((rejected + 1))
            ;;
    esac
done
for request in "$@"; do
    if [ -n "$request" ]; then
        printf '%s=<%s>\n' "$request" "${latest[$request]}"
    fi
done
printf 'Entries: %s\nRejected: %s\n' "${#latest[@]}" "$rejected"
shell-map-reconcile.alternate:
declare -A latest
rejected=0
skip() {
    printf 'Skipped: %s\n' "$line" >&2
    rejected=$((rejected + 1))
}
consume() {
    case "$line" in
        *'|'*'|'*) skip ;;
        *'|'*)
            key=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d '|' -f 1)
            if [ -n "$key" ]; then
                value=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d '|' -f 2)
                latest["$key"]="$value"
            else
                skip
            fi
            ;;
        *) skip ;;
    esac
}
while IFS= read -r line; do consume; done
if [ -n "$line" ]; then consume; fi
for request in "$@"; do
    if [ -n "$request" ]; then
        printf '%s=<%s>\n' "$request" "${latest[$request]}"
    fi
done
printf 'Entries: %s\nRejected: %s\n' "${#latest[@]}" "$rejected"
